prompts.prompt: Search my Notion workspace for pages about quarterly planning and show me the most recently edited ones.
assertions: Uses notion_search with a query parameter
Includes sort by last_edited_time in descending order
Returns page titles and IDs from results

Extract each result's title and id from the returned results array and present them in descending edit-time order.

prompts.prompt: Create a new page called 'Sprint 12 Retrospective' under the page with ID abc123, with a paragraph block summarizing the sprint outcomes and an emoji icon
assertions: Passes properties with title set to 'Sprint 12 Retrospective'
Includes children array with at least one paragraph block containing content
Sets icon parameter with an emoji type

prompts.prompt: Fetch the page at https://www.notion.so/MyPage-def456, update its title to 'Updated Roadmap', then add a comment saying 'Reviewed and approved for Q2'
assertions: Uses notion_fetch with the Notion URL to retrieve the page
Uses notion_update_page with page_id and updated title properties
Uses notion_create_comment with page_id and rich_text containing the review message

with_skill.plan: 1. Call notion_fetch(page_id='https://www.notion.so/MyPage-def456') to retrieve the page and extract its ID. 2. Call notion_update_page(page_id=<extracted_id>, properties={'title': [{'text': {'content': 'Updated Roadmap'}}]}) to rename it. 3. Call notion_create_comment(page_id=<extracted_id>, rich_text=[{'type': 'text', 'text': {'content': 'Reviewed and approved for Q2'}}]) to add the comment.
